entries.title: James 3:1
segments: ¶Be not many teachers, my brethren, knowing that we shall receive greater judgment.

entries.title: James 3:2
segments: For we all often offend. If any one offend not in word, *he* [is] a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body too.

entries.title: James 3:3
segments: Behold, we put the bits in the mouths of the horses, that they may obey us, and we turn round their whole bodies.

entries.title: James 3:4
segments: Behold also the ships, which are so great, and driven by violent winds, are turned about by a very small rudder, wherever the pleasure of the helmsman will.

entries.title: James 3:5
segments: Thus also the tongue is a little member, and boasts great things. See how little a fire, how large a wood it kindles!

entries.title: James 3:6
segments: and the tongue [is] fire, the world of unrighteousness; the tongue is set in our members, the defiler of the whole body, and which sets fire to the course of nature, and is set on fire of hell.

entries.title: James 3:7
segments: For every species both of beasts and of birds, both of creeping things and of sea animals, is tamed and has been tamed by the human species;

entries.title: James 3:8
segments: but the tongue can no one among men tame; [it is] an unsettled evil, full of death-bringing poison.

entries.title: James 3:9
segments: Therewith bless we the Lord and Father, and therewith curse we men made after [the] likeness of God.

entries.title: James 3:10
segments: Out of the same mouth goes forth blessing and cursing. It is not right, my brethren, that these things should be thus.

entries.title: James 3:11
segments: Does the fountain, out of the same opening, pour forth sweet and bitter?

entries.title: James 3:12
segments: Can, my brethren, a fig produce olives, or a vine figs? Neither [can] salt [water] make sweet water.

entries.title: James 3:13
segments: ¶Who [is] wise and understanding among you; let him shew out of a good conversation his works in meekness of wisdom;

entries.title: James 3:14
segments: but if ye have bitter emulation and strife in your hearts, do not boast and lie against the truth.

entries.title: James 3:15
segments: This is not the wisdom which comes down from above, but earthly, natural, devilish.

entries.title: James 3:16
segments: For where emulation and strife [are], there [is] disorder and every evil thing.

entries.title: James 3:17
segments: But the wisdom from above first is pure, then peaceful, gentle, yielding, full of mercy and good fruits, unquestioning, unfeigned.

entries.title: James 3:18
segments: But [the] fruit of righteousness in peace is sown for them that make peace.
